title: Stage and member binding
summary: Sessions walk shared QA groups concurrently; a member whose owed groups are all held retains its claim and parks. Failed QA recovery rereads remaining blockers and run/stage/member/target evidence. A cleared dependency cannot change the old frozen target; a correction outside that lineage requires a qualifying later deployed candidate. Case target_envs selects registered environments independently of optional stage_reason metadata; every target retains its own immutable obligation and acceptance evidence. Deployment case identity follows durable correction links across plans and receipt changes within each subject and shared group. The newest chain end decides work; passed cases keep their frozen definitions while unpassed cases can be corrected independently.
